A [[Color/Legends|black]]-[[Hair/Legends|haired]] '''Human male''' was an [[Imperial Knight]] in [[137 ABY]]. In that [[Standard year/Legends|year]], he was among a group of Knights who acted as [[Bodyguard/Legends|bodyguards]] for [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Roan Fel]] of the [[Empire-in-exile]] as Fel [[Mission to Agamar|met]] with several [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Agamar/Legends|Agamar]] to negotiate an alliance against [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire]]. Everyone present wore a [[Farm/Legends|farmer]] disguise, and the black-haired [[Gender/Legends|male]] was one of several Knights who stood apart from the talks and pretended to work on a nearby field. When a [[One Sith|Sith]] [[First Sith Imperial Strikeforce|strike force]] [[Operation: Thunderstroke|attacked]] the gathering, the black-haired male helped fight them off. Most of the Jedi and the Imperial Knights, including the Emperor, were able to evacuate the planet.

==Biography==
During the [[Second Imperial Civil War]], a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] with short-cropped [[Color/Legends|black]] [[Hair/Legends|hair]] was a member of the [[Imperial Knight]]s,<ref name="Legacy 46" /> a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-using]] order whose members were loyal to [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Roan Fel]] of the [[Empire-in-exile]].<ref name="LECG">''[[Legacy Era Campaign Guide]]''</ref> The Emperor traveled to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Agamar/Legends|Agamar]] in [[137 ABY]] to meet with members of the [[New Jedi Order|Jedi Order]], and the black-haired male was one of many Imperial Knights who served as [[Bodyguard/Legends|bodyguards]] for Fel on the [[Mission to Agamar|mission]].<ref name="Legacy 46" /> [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire]] was a common enemy of both the Empire-in-Exile and the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], and Fel hoped to forge an alliance against [[Darth Krayt|Krayt's]] forces.<ref name="Legacy 45">[[Legacy (2006) 45|''Legacy'' (2006) 45]]</ref>

On Agamar's [[Grass/Legends|grassy]] plains, everyone present donned a [[Farm/Legends|farmer]] disguise, and several Imperial Knight Masters stood with Fel as he negotiated with [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[K'Kruhk]].<ref name="Legacy 45" /> The black-haired male and several other Imperial Knights stood away from the main group and promoted their farmer deception by masquerading as workers tending to a nearby field.<ref name="Legacy 46" /> After Fel and K'Kruhk reached an agreement, [[Morrigan Corde|Nyna Calixte]]&mdash;the [[Director of Imperial Intelligence]] for Krayt's Empire, and secretly an ally of Fel's&mdash;rode into the field on a [[Agamarian beast|local animal]]. She crashed to a halt after two Imperial Knights fired [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifles]] at her steed; she then quickly told the assembled parties that Krayt's [[One Sith|Sith]] were aware of the meeting and that a [[Sith/Legends|Sith]]&ndash;Imperial [[First Sith Imperial Strikeforce|task force]] was on its way to capture or [[Death/Legends|kill]] the Emperor.<ref name="Legacy 45" />

A group of Sith then rose from an adjacent swamp, and [[Antares Draco]],<ref name="Legacy 46" /> the leader of the Imperial Knights,<ref name="LECG" /> called on his charges to defend their Emperor. The black-haired male ignited his [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]], and all farmer disguises were jettisoned as a [[Operation: Thunderstroke|melee]] ensued. Newly-allied Jedi and Imperial Knights fought off the attackers, and at least ten Sith fell to their blades and to Calixte's [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]].<ref name="Legacy 46" /> Several Jedi and Imperial Knights died as well,<ref name="Legacy 48">[[Legacy (2006) 48|''Legacy'' (2006) 48]]</ref> but the Emperor and most of the survivors were able to evacuate the planet on the escape [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] ''[[Defender One]]''.<ref name="Legacy 46" />

==Powers and abilities==
As an Imperial Knight, the black-haired male was part of an order<ref name="Legacy 46" /> whose membership was limited to those who could use [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. The Imperial Knights were dedicated to protecting the Emperor and preserving his Empire, and were considered to be among the most talented and dangerous Force-users in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="LECG" />

==Equipment==
The man fought against a group of Sith on Agamar with a standard [[Imperial Knight lightsaber]] and while wearing [[Imperial Knight armor]].<ref name="Legacy 46" /> While disguised on the world, he wore farmer's [[Clothing/Legends|attire]].<ref name="Legacy 45" />

==Behind the scenes==
Created by [[John Ostrander]] and [[Jan Duursema]], the black-haired male first appeared in the [[Legacy (2006) 45|forty-fifth]] issue of the [[Star Wars comic books|comic]] series ''[[Star Wars: Legacy]]''.<ref name="Legacy 45" /> The installment was released on [[February 24]], [[2010]].<ref name="Marvel">{{Marvel|url=comics/issue/54417/star_wars_legacy_2006_45|text=Star Wars: Legacy (2006) #45}}</ref>
